questions.stem: A 7-year-old child presents with symptoms indicative of acute pyelonephritis, including high fever, flank pain and nausea. The child is stable but unable to tolerate oral medications. What is the most appropriate initial treatment for this child?

options.label: A
options.text: Start oral Nitrofurantoin and follow with a 3-day course of antibiotics.

options.label: B
options.text: Begin intravenous Ceftriaxone and transition to oral Cefixime after 3 days.

options.label: C
options.text: Administer oral Amoxicillin and monitor foR 5 days.

options.label: D
options.text: Initiate treatment with intravenous Fluoroquinolones and assess afteR 7 days.
